said.meaning: where letters overlap the left one wins and the right one is cut around it (one gap, as the leg of the R around its bowl); the R's bowl 72 in the Regular and 88 in the Bold (read as one width per weight)

decided.rSpacing: by its top (stem and bowl), the leg reaching into the next letter's room
decided.overlap: left wins; the right letter is cut one gap around the overlapping pieces; slivers dropped; touching is not overlapping, so the arm of the 4 still joins

seen.RE RN RR RB: the next stem is cut round the leg
seen.RA: the A's diagonal is cut round the leg, the leg passing in front as in the X; its foot comes away, so in the Bold the A may read as 4
